282407031.description:
Offered is a collection of four decorative, figural tobacco smoking pipes housed in two fitted presentation cases.
The pipes feature detailed cream-colored carved bowls with assorted figural and decorative designs, including bearded portraits, a helmeted figure, and grape-and-foliage motifs. Each pipe is fitted with a curved, translucent amber-brown and dark tortoiseshell-pattern stem.
The bowls resemble carved meerschaum; however, the exact material has not been independently verified. The stem material, manufacturer, age, and country of origin are unknown.
One presentation case bears a label reading "SULTAN BACCNUS SET 87601." No manufacturer has been confirmed from this label.
Included Contents:
Four carved figural tobacco smoking pipes
Two black textured fitted presentation cases with gold-colored fabric interiors
Condition:
Previously owned condition with visible signs of age, handling, and storage. The carved bowls display fine decorative detailing with some minor surface marks. The stems show light visible surface wear. The presentation cases have exterior scuffing and wear, with creasing, impressions, and areas of wear to the interior fabric linings.
Testing status: Untested: No functional testing was performed.
The pipes have not been evaluated for airflow, smoking performance, internal residue, stem tightness, or concealed damage. Previous smoking use is unknown. The presence or absence of internal cracks or repairs has not been established.
Only the four pictured pipes and two presentation cases are included. No additional accessories are included.
This item was donated and previously owned; its complete history is unknown. Photographs are part of the description. Only photographed contents are included unless specifically stated otherwise. Measurements are approximate, and colors may vary due to lighting or display settings. Descriptions may contain unintentional errors. Buyers should review all photographs and ask questions before bidding. The item is sold AS-IS according to the testing and condition stated above.

282095829.description: This lot includes 9 natural mineral specimens primarily composed of selenite, a crystalline form of gypsum. The pieces range in translucency from translucent to transparent and exhibit a pearly luster. Most specimens are colorless or white, with one showing a light tan hue. The crystals display characteristic striated and bladed formations and are in raw, unpolished condition with some natural edge chipping. These selenite specimens are suitable for mineral collectors, metaphysical applications, or educational purposes.
